name: Browse Abandonment
goal: Turn a product view into a confident next step (the right size, a material sample or a quick call) without discounting, and help Design Your Own visitors finish their custom piece.
trigger: Viewed Product (Klaviyo metric from onsite tracking / the Miva integration). Design Your Own builder pages (/BUILDER-COR.html, /BUILDER-BKT.html, /BUILDER-FLT.html, /BM.html) must also fire Viewed Product, or a custom 'Viewed Builder' event, so they route to branch C.
flow_filters: Started Checkout zero times since starting this flow
Placed Order zero times since starting this flow
Has not been in this flow in the last 14 days
Is not currently in the Cart flow
Is not currently in the Post-Purchase, Sample-to-Order, Depot Dollars or Back in Stock flows (all outrank Browse)
Can receive email marketing; BRW-S1 also requires SMS consent
exit_conditions: Started Checkout: exits (the Cart flow takes over)
Unsubscribes from email (email steps stop) or replies STOP (SMS steps stop)
smart_sending: Email ON (16h). SMS ON (24h), quiet hours 10am-8pm local, counts toward the 3-per-7-days SMS cap.

branches.label: Custom builder
branches.rule: Triggering view is a Design Your Own builder page: URL contains /BUILDER- (corbels, brackets, flat trim) or is /BM.html (faux wood beams).

build_notes: Viewed Product payload needs: ProductName, ProductID, URL, ImageURL, Price, Categories and an is_made_to_order flag. {{ category_name }} maps to the primary category with fallback 'millwork' (the subject then reads 'Still planning your millwork project?').

Branch C: add the Klaviyo onsite snippet to the builder pages so they send Viewed Product with the page URL and a builder_type property (beam, corbel, bracket, flat trim). If they can only send a custom event, build branch C as its own flow on that event with the same filters, and add 'has not been in Browse (custom) in the last 14 days' to the standard flow.
For branch C, {{ product_url }} is the builder page they viewed. Builder entries may not be saved between visits, so the copy never promises a saved design.
BRW-E1's 'If it's made to order' callout is a show/hide block: show only when the viewed product is made to order (e.g. vinyl or wood shutters).

BRW-E2 recommendations: Klaviyo catalog feed, same category as the viewed product, in stock, excluding the viewed item. Swap the hero image by category with show/hide image blocks (beams, corbels, shutters, mantels, moulding, other).
BRW-E2 review block: pull a real review for the viewed category from the customer reviews page. If none exists for that category, use a real review about help choosing size or finish. Quote verbatim.

BRW-S1 condition: Klaviyo splits can't match against the trigger's product, so either (a) send a site-side 'Repeat Viewed Product' event when the same product is viewed 2+ times in 7 days and split on it, or (b) approximate with 'Viewed Product at least 3 times in the last 7 days'. Prefer (a).
BRW-S1 sends at day 1 in both branches (it sits above the branch split).

blocks.title: Three ways to decide with confidence

items.title: Check the specs
items.text: Compare the listed dimensions with your space: beam length, corbel depth, shutter height, mantel width. Painter's tape on the wall or ceiling shows you the scale.

items.title: See the material in person
items.text: Polyurethane and Timberthane faux wood samples, plus vinyl shutter color kits, let you judge color and texture in your own light.

items.title: Talk it through
items.text: Call 1-888-573-3768 with your measurements and we'll help you choose the size and material. Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT, Sat 8am-12pm CT.

blocks.title: If it's made to order
blocks.text: Made-to-order pieces, like vinyl and wood shutters, are built to your size and finish after you order, so they can't be returned. Double-check your measurements before you buy; we're glad to check them with you.
And when you're ready, every qualifying order earns 5% back in Depot Dollars.

hero.headline: Three checks before you choose
hero.subhead: Size, material and finish decide whether millwork looks built-in or added-on. Here's how to get each one right.
hero.image: Dynamic by viewed category: Timberthane beams across a vaulted ceiling, corbels under a kitchen island overhang, shutters on a two-story facade; fallback is a mantel with crown moulding in a living room.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, whatever you're adding, the same three decisions make it look like it was always part of the house.

items.title: Size it to the space
items.text: Proportion is everything. Shutters should look like they'd cover the window if closed, corbels should suit the overhang they sit under, and beams should fit your ceiling span and spacing.

items.title: Match the material to the spot
items.text: Timberthane faux wood is maintenance-free. AmeriCraft is stain-grade real wood. Going outside? Tell us where and we'll steer you to the right material.

items.title: See it in your light
items.text: Order a material sample and hold it next to your floors, cabinets or siding at different times of day.

hero.headline: Let's finish your custom piece
hero.subhead: Custom corbels, brackets, flat trim and faux wood beams, built to your measurements. Here's how to get the numbers right.
hero.image: Process shot: hands with a tape measure under a counter overhang or along a ceiling run, notepad with dimensions; inset screenshot of the real builder page.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, you started designing a custom piece. Getting it right comes down to a few measurements, and we're happy to help with any of them.

items.title: Measure the spot
items.text: Beams: the length of each run, plus the width and depth you want. Corbels and brackets: the depth of the overhang and the height you have. Flat trim: length and width.

items.title: Enter your size, then style it
items.text: Put your dimensions into the builder, then choose the profile and finish options.

items.title: Double-check, then order
items.text: Custom pieces are made to order for you, so they can't be returned. A second look at your numbers is time well spent.

blocks.title: Send us your dimensions
blocks.text: Call 1-888-573-3768 (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT, Sat 8am-12pm CT) or email cs@architecturaldepot.com with your measurements and a photo of the space. We'll help you confirm the size before it's built.
